//selfTestRuntime: A GameAssembly.dll for the `--side sim` self-test to bind against, so it reports real bindings offline. Empty -- which is what ships -- means the process, and under aowlspt-sim there is no runtime at all. It must be an ABSOLUTE path: a relative one resolves against whatever directory the host was started in, which in an install is the game's own directory, and it is refused with that reason. `aowl test` and `aowl run` set AOWLSPT_SELFTEST_RUNTIME to the stand-in runtime tests/mockil2cpp builds, which is why this key is empty here and nothing ships a fixture path into an install.
//selfTestDataDir: The *_Data directory il2cpp_init is given when selfTestRuntime was loaded out of process -- a real client's EscapeFromTarkov_Data. Empty means the runtime is started without one, which is right for the stand-in and wrong for a real GameAssembly.dll. Absolute paths only, same rule and same reason as selfTestRuntime; AOWLSPT_SELFTEST_DATADIR sets it for a whole run. The mod has read this key since the self-test learned to start a runtime, so it is declared here where it can be found.
